title: Gauge coupling unification and doublet-triplet splitting via GUT dynamical breaking
summary: An interesting framework to achieve gauge coupling unification consists in adding to the Standard Model Lagrangian non-renormalizable operators of $d \geq 5$, which affect the kinetic term of gauge fields. We first review the phenomenology related to this framework in the context of $SU(5)$, identifying which are the most interesting representations for the sake of achieving coupling unification.
